newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to redeem callables notes due Aug 1,'97.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to redeem callables notes due Aug 1,'97.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Friday it will redeem the entire sum of its 6.10 percent callable notes due Aug 1, 1997.
The principal and final interest payment for the 6.10 percent notes are due and payable on Nov 1, 1996 to holders of record at the close of business on Oct 31, Sallie Mae said.
It said principal will be repaid at 100 pct of the face amount. Accrued interest of $15.25 per $1,000 face value will be paid on Nov 1.
The notes have a cusip number of 86387RVC3.
